findings.finding: H1 FY27 was pre-released on 20 Oct: revenue about -4.2% YoY, EBIT margin about 7.4%, in line. The interim numbers themselves carry no new information unless the pre-release is revised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Interim days moved +1.14% (Nov 2023), +1.92% (Nov 2024) and 0.0% (Nov 2025). The pre-close update days carry the moves: -21.5% in Jan 2024, -6.4% in Sep 2025, -1.86% on 20 Oct 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The stock fell 2.3% on the day (AJ Bell) and has since recovered to 87p. Filed at 0 for completeness.

findings.finding: The company-quoted FY27 revenue consensus of £214m implies H2 revenue of about £112.6m (214 minus about 101.4 for H1). That is about +10% on H2 FY26's £102.6m (208.4 minus 105.8), against a disclosed £8m FY27 headwind from Malaysia and the Middle East and soft NA/Asia auto. The release may reset revenue expectations even if EBIT is held through margin.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue softness with EBIT held has been tolerated: FY26 revenue fell about 7% and the April 2026 statement still drew -3.94%. Consensus EBIT already slipped from £18.6m to £18.2m between 7 Sep and 20 Oct, and the stock fell 1.86% on 20 Oct.
findings.why_not_priced: The implied H2 acceleration is not stated anywhere. It only appears by combining the H1 FY26 base (Nov 2025 RNS), the FY26 total (Jul 2026), the -4.2% (Oct 2026) and the £8m headwind (Apr 2026). The company called trading 'in line' with £214m four weeks ago, which is why this is small. If the market had priced a revenue cut, the stock would not have rerated +5% into the print.
findings.independence: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/trifast--tri/half-year-financial-report/9239758 (H1 FY26 revenue £105.8m) and https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/trifast--tri/trading-statement/9542855 (the £8m headwind). These come from the same issuer, so they are not independent of the company.

findings.finding: The Board is targeting double-digit underlying EBIT margins in H2 FY27, 'ahead of our stated timeframe' for the >10% medium-term target. That implies H2 EBIT of about £10.4-10.7m and supports FY EBIT of about £18m even with lower revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin-led statements have drawn modest positive reactions: +2.56% at the FY26 results (Jul 2026) and +4.17% in Feb 2026.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the target was published on 20 Oct. Only a firmer quantification at the interims would add anything, so the size is near 0.

findings.finding: The capital reduction creates about £38.9m of distributable reserves (merger reserve £16.3m plus share premium £22.6m) 'to support the Company's ability to pay dividends'. The Court hearing is expected on 17 Nov, the release day. The interim dividend (prior 0.60p) is likely to be maintained or raised.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior surprise on this line. The FY26 final was raised 1.80p to 1.90p and the stock rose 2.56% that day, together with the margin beat.
findings.why_not_priced: The yield is about 3% (2.5p on 87p), so a dividend tweak is small money. Any upside comes from an unflagged capital-return statement, which is possible but not indicated in any document.

findings.why_not_priced: It is public. It says an informed long-only holder was buying after seeing the H1 pre-close, which mildly supports the guide holding. The run-up from 80.4p to 87p suggests it is at least partly reflected.
